QuestInfo.2: The Genesis Weapon was filled with your resolve. Zigang asked what was the answer you found at the end of the fight. You recalled the Black Mage's intention speculated by Neinheart and the final conversation you had with the White Mage. With that, the Genesis Weapon awakened into the Destiny Weapon.
